background_story: Alex was a brilliant and charismatic scholar of ancient Greek history. His fascination with the works of Homer and Sophocles led him to become an expert in the field of scolia, the ancient Greek songs and poems that accompanied symposia and banquets. As a professor at a prestigious university, Alex would often regale his students with tales of the scolia, bringing the ancient world to life with his infectious enthusiasm. His groundbreaking research on the subject led to the publication of a seminal book, which became a benchmark for scholars worldwide. Alex's love for scolia also inspired him to create a modern-day revival of the ancient tradition, hosting scolia-themed dinner parties that became the stuff of legend among his colleagues and friends.
